citations.desc: Attending veterinarian and adequate veterinary care (dealers and exhibitors).
citations.narrative:
The licensee has a formal arrangement with a part-time veterinarian who is the Attending Veterinarian (AV) and provides
veterinary care for the animals. However, the written Program of Veterinary Care from the AV was misplaced or lost and
the required document was not available for review at the time of the inspection.
Per this Section, each exhibitor shall employ an attending veterinarian under formal arrangements. In the case of a part-
time Attending Veterinarian (AV) or consultant arrangements, the formal arrangements shall include a written Program of
Veterinary Care (PVC). The written PVC provides information regarding the medical care provided by the Attending
Veterinarian to the animals and should be available for review at the time of an inspection. The licensee needs to obtain a
written PVC from the AV and ensure that it is available for review at the time of inspections. Correct by 6/26/26.

The acquisition records for the beaver and groundhog as well as the record of animals on hand were misplaced or lost,
and these required records were not available for review at the time of the inspection.
Per this Section, exhibitors shall make and maintain complete records regarding the details of the acquisition of animals in
their possession in order to account for the sources and transfers of all of the animals. The Licensee needs to: prepare
records of acquisition for the beaver and groundhog; prepare a record of animals on hand; and ensure that the animal
records are kept current and available for review at the time of inspections. Correct by 6/26/26.
This inspection and exit briefing were conducted with licensee.
*END OF REPORT*
